notes: Windows native examples; extract only verified assets listed in native-sources.json. Run in isolated test directories and stop only processes started for this instance.
All listeners explicitly bind loopback; set individual flags to choose other dedicated ports. Jaeger in-memory storage is ephemeral and bounded.
Prometheus scrape targets in prometheus.yaml are local defaults and can be changed in a private generated copy.
Set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT to the same isolated Jaeger gRPC port if overriding the default, so Jaeger self-telemetry cannot contact an unrelated localhost collector.
